text_block_list.text: —It was the final day of a fruitful summer training camp. Day and night, Tamamo Cross had devoted herself to mastering her new form...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, Trainer! My new running style's
looking pretty sharp, ain't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you've pretty much mastered it
Yeah, you've pretty much mastered it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If only my lower body could get a bit bulkier.
Can't I do somethin' about this?"
choice_data_list: I guess we'll have to wait for some growth there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Waiting for growth, huh... Gaaah, what a harsh world this is, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, Tama-chan is
still a child, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Looks a lot like Tome-san's nephew...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold up! I ain't about to be
treated like a kid by a bunch of Junior-class rookies!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Besides, Oguri, what's with 'nephew'? At least call her a niece!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—!?
Tome-san has a... niece!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, no! That's not
what I meant at all!
A routine back-and-forth of funny quips and straight-man retorts. These lively days, too, draw to a temporary close today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So Oguri, what about you? Did you sort out that issue with your running?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the cornering has improved a lot.
Once we debut in the Twinkle Series, we can take it
step by step...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm still far from catching up to Tama,
but I intend to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I see. I know I'm the one who asked for help, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You can do it! I know ya can!
Just like how I overcame everything
that was thrown at me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed. I still have a long way to go, but I'll do my best, and someday—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It would be nice if the day comes when we can all run together like this summer~. Next time, on the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Someday, the three of us!

Whether it would come true depended on what lay ahead.
The faint promise melted into the summer evening sky.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, rather than worry about what might happen way down the line,
first I gotta set an example as a senior.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Just watch me this autumn. I'll make it roar
across the racetrack! The reborn White Lightning, that is!"
